attackers_goals: The attacker attempts to gain access to the service accounts.
description: A service account attempted to authenticate to a target using NTLM an excessive number of times in a short period. This may indicate a NTLM brute-force attack.
investigative_actions: Verify any successful authentication by the user account referenced by the alert, as these can indicate the attacker managed to guess the credentials.
name: NTLM Brute Force on a Service Account
